blind_target.title: Culture’s Consequences: International Differences in Work-Related Values.
blind_target.evidence_quote:
Items in the IBM questionnaire used by Hofstede for computing his original uncertainty
avoidance index (Hofstede, 1980, 2001)
blind_target.outcome_quote:
We have successfully replicated Hofstede’s UA dimension with nationally representative samples
from Europe, using three highly intercorrelated items from ESS 2010 that form a strong single factor.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly conclude successful replication of the IBM uncertainty-avoidance dimension in nationally representative ESS samples. The 2001 second edition is another account of the same original IBM finding, not an independent target. Earlier replication attempts, other dimensions, and external validation sources are contextual or validation comparisons, not separately retested originals.

archived_opening_target.evidence_quote: In this study, we use 2010 European Social Survey data for 25 European countries and Israel and obtain a close replication of Hofstede’s uncertainty avoidance ( r = 0.81, p < 0.001, n = 17) with strong face validity, internal reliability, and similar predictive properties to those of the original measure.

archived_opening_target.outcome_reasoning: The abstract explicitly reports a close replication with similar predictive properties. Target bibliographic identity is unavailable and does not reduce confidence in that stated verdict.

blind_target.authors: Nelms, L.W., & Hutchins, E., Hutchins, D., & Pursley, R.
blind_target.title: Spirituality and the health of college students.
blind_target.evidence_quote:
The purpose of this study was
to partially replicate and extend the findings of Nelms et al. (2007) on the relationship between spirituality
and the health of university students.
blind_target.outcome_quote:
In keeping with the findings of Nelms et al. (2007), we found that
undergraduate students’ self-reported higher level of spirituality was positively related to student self-
reported level of physical health, emotional health, and exercise/sports.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: All three retested spirituality-health relationships are explicitly described as agreeing with Nelms et al. Gender and race analyses extend the original and do not constitute failed replication components.
